title: 2026 Worlds Tee (Green) Avatar Item
description: Redeem this promo code for the 2026 Worlds Tee (Green) avatar item from the 2026 Pokémon World Championships. Expires Friday, September 11, 2026, at 20:00 UTC. More details[here](https://leekduck.com/events/pokemon-world-championships-2026-timed-research-twitch-drops/).

title: MLB-branded T-shirt Avatar Item
description: To celebrate the Pokémon GO and Major League Baseball collaboration returning for the 2026 season, trainers can redeem this code to get an exclusive MLB-branded T-shirt avatar item. Learn more[here](https://pokemongo.com/post/mlb-2026).

title: GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale – 1M Check-Ins
description: To help Trainers prepare for Armored Mewtwo, Pokémon GO will release this promo code after the community reaches 1 million check-ins during Mega Ascension and Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale; the challenge runs through September 6.

title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Cap Timed Research
description: Redeem this promo code for Bonus Timed Research that awards berries, XP, Stardust, and the 2026 LEGO® Pokémon Cap. The Cap Timed Research is only available in select countries, including but not exclusive to the ones with participating LEGO Stores. Trainers in countries that are not included will get Timed Research that rewards a Lucky Egg instead. Research details[here](https://leekduck.com/events/lego-pokemon-go-2026/).

title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Berries
description: Promo code for free berries and Poké Balls tied to the Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership. Learn more[here](https://leekduck.com/events/lego-pokemon-go-2026/).

title: FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON Hoodie Avatar Item
description: Trainers can redeem this code to get an exclusive FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON hoodie avatar item. (This code should have expired on January 4, 2025 but it appears to still work.)

rewards.name: FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON hoodie
